title: completion-manifest
description: Phase 1 (plan_26072506) OUTPUT contract: the stable JSON .claude/policies/runtime/completion_gate.py prints to stdout for `verify --manifest <path>`. state is the single source of truth for completion state; prose docs must not self-judge state. Invariant: state == 'promotion-ready' if and only if eligible_for_promotion == true; this is machine-enforced by allOf/if/then below. state is a strict 3-value named-lifecycle vocabulary (runtime-ready | evidence-complete | promotion-ready) PLUS null. null is NOT a 4th named lifecycle state -- it is the pre-lifecycle/invalid-input sentinel meaning 'has not yet reached runtime-ready', for either reason: malformed/schema-invalid input (exit_code=2) or a well-formed manifest whose runtime/capacity_rejection tier is not yet satisfied (exit_code=1). The two cases are distinguished by exit_code and reason_codes, never by a separate state token -- completion_gate.py emits exactly the same 3 non-null state values plus this one sentinel, never anything else. Every field this document (.claude/policies/runtime/completion_gate.py:_emit) ever includes is declared below and self-validated against this very schema before being printed (additionalProperties:false at every level -- an internal bug that produces a field this schema doesn't know about is a programmer error, not swallowed as an exit-2 result).

allOf.description: OUTPUT_SCHEMA_EXIT_STATE_GAP fix: state == 'promotion-ready' implies exit_code == 0 -- the prior state<->eligible_for_promotion biconditional alone still left exit_code free to contradict both (e.g. promotion-ready + eligible=true + exit_code=1 was schema-valid).

OUTPUT_SCHEMA_EXIT_STATE_GAP fix: exit_code == 0 implies state == 'promotion-ready' and eligible_for_promotion == true (e.g. evidence-complete + eligible=false + exit_code=0 was schema-valid before this rule).

OUTPUT_SCHEMA_EXIT_STATE_GAP fix: state in {runtime-ready, evidence-complete} implies exit_code == 1 and eligible_for_promotion == false -- neither named non-promotion state may ever carry a success or invalid-input exit code.
OUTPUT_SCHEMA_EXIT_STATE_GAP fix: state == null implies eligible_for_promotion == false and exit_code in {1, 2} -- the pre-lifecycle sentinel is never a success exit code.
OUTPUT_SCHEMA_EXIT_STATE_GAP fix: exit_code == 2 implies state == null -- invalid-input is always pre-lifecycle, never a named state.

state.description: Strict 3-value named-lifecycle vocabulary (runtime-ready, evidence-complete, promotion-ready) plus the null pre-lifecycle sentinel. See top-level description for the null-is-not-a-4th-state rationale.

reason_codes.description: Deterministic, sorted (lexicographic) list of stable machine-readable codes. Never contains prose.

messages.description: Human-readable prose, one entry per reason_code, keyed by code -- deliberately NOT interleaved into reason_codes so consumers can pattern-match codes without prose language dependence.

type.description: Filesystem type actually observed for this evidence item, from the same hardened dir_fd/O_NOFOLLOW stat used to compute the hash/fingerprint below. null when the path could not be resolved at all (missing/escaped/symlink).

identity.description: Echo of the input manifest's identity block, for downstream consumers that only read the gate's output.

rubric.description: 승격 판정에 실제로 쓰인 루브릭 사실과 **그 출처**(헌법 §결정론 규율 출처 표시). authority_source='certificate' = PASS 런의 인증서 아티팩트에서 파싱 · 'manifest_benchmark' = REFUTE 런처럼 인증서가 구조적으로 없을 때 manifest.benchmark 가 나른 판정기 산출물 파생분(plan_26082405) · null = 어느 carrier 도 rubric 을 선언하지 않음. contract_ok 는 두 carrier 모두 같은 계약(floor>0 ∧ ratio 유한 ∧ primary_source 실재 ∧ authority 값역)을 통과했는지이며, explore 자동개방(U1)의 전제다.

certificate.description: Present only when evidence.certificate was declared and its path resolved to a real regular file; carries what was actually parsed from the flat-YAML artifact on disk (never the manifest's own claims -- there are none, evidence.certificate has no identity sub-object per work-manifest.schema.json). null when no certificate evidence was checked.

rubric_authority.description: 루브릭 정본 권한(weak|explicit|explore), 인증서 아티팩트에서 파싱. legacy 인증서(필드 부재)는 null -- 값역 위반만 CERTIFICATE_RUBRIC_AUTHORITY_UNKNOWN 으로 차단한다(plan_26082219 D5).

floor_tps.description: 인증서가 선언한 PASS 문턱(primary x (1-tolerance)). 유한 양수가 아니면 CERTIFICATE_RUBRIC_FLOOR_INVALID -- floor<=0 은 문턱 없는 '공허 PASS' 이며 어떤 authority 로도 승격 불가.

ratio_M_over_primary.description: 측정치/루브릭 비. 유한수가 아니면 CERTIFICATE_RUBRIC_RATIO_MISSING -- 지표가 사라진 PASS 는 감사 불가.

primary_source.description: 낙찰된 루브릭 칸의 라벨. **표면화 전용** -- 문자열 매칭을 게이트로 쓰지 않는다(하드코딩 결함 칸). 부재/N/A 는 CERTIFICATE_RUBRIC_SOURCE_MISSING.

rubric_contract_ok.description: 위 세 수치 계약 + authority 값역을 모두 만족했는가. explore 승격 경로(U1)의 전제 조건.

run_key.description: 이 인증서가 식별하는 측정 = 강한 6키 + measured_utc(completion_gate.certificate_run_key). 결측이면 null 이고 CERTIFICATE_RUN_KEY_UNRESOLVABLE 로 차단된다(식별 불가 = 매치 없음이 아니다).

duplicates.description: 같은 측정 키를 가진 **다른** 추적 인증서(repo-relative). 비어 있지 않으면 CERTIFICATE_RUN_AMBIGUOUS — 같은 사실이 두 자리에 있어 승격 불가(plan_26090410 §3.2).

exit_code.description: Mirrors the process exit code actually used for this evaluation (0=success/promotion-ready, 1=policy-block, 2=invalid-input). Included so JSON-only consumers (that did not capture $?) can still branch.
